name: Pasdiu
description: WebMCP machine-readable tool definitions for Pasdiu marketing platform.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Get key information about Pasdiu marketing site, available features, pricing tiers, and contact options.

tools.name: calculate_pricing
tools.description: Get the flat subscription cost for a Pasdiu tier. Pricing is per workspace, not per seat — team size never changes the price, it only determines which tier a team fits in.

teamSize.description: Number of team members. Does not affect price — used only to check the tier's seat allowance. Client reviewer users never count.

tools.name: contact_pasdiu
tools.description: Send a message to the Pasdiu team with your name, work email, optional company, team size, and a message.
